description: This file is a Lua script demonstrating usage of a Vector class or module, including creation, arithmetic operations, mutability, dot product, distance calculation, and swizzling.

classes.name: Vector
classes.description: A class representing a mathematical vector with operations like addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, dot product, distance, and swizzling.

methods.name: createVector
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Vector instance with specified components.

methods.name: a:add
methods.description: Adds a vector or scalar to vector a.

methods.name: a:sub
methods.description: Subtracts a vector or scalar from vector a.

methods.name: a:mult
methods.description: Multiplies vector a by a vector or scalar.

methods.name: a:div
methods.description: Divides vector a by a vector or scalar.

methods.name: a:dot
methods.description: Computes the dot product of vector a with another vector or scalar.

methods.name: a:dist
methods.description: Calculates the distance between vector a and another vector.
